project_info.theme: Samsung.com only Galaxy S25 and S25+ color lineup poster
project_info.color_palette: Off-white background, graphite black, coral pink, warm champagne, soft pink screen glow

main_subject.detail: Minimal white-background product poster presenting three back-color variants of the Galaxy S25/S25+ beside one front-facing phone with a pink wallpaper, under a centered Samsung.com-only headline.
main_subject.style: Clean premium ecommerce product render, minimalist launch poster, airy Samsung visual identity

composition_elements.text: Samsung.com only / Galaxy S25 | S25+ / Galaxy AI
items: Top Left: Large centered black title 'Samsung.com only'.
Top Right: Centered smaller lockup 'Galaxy S25 | S25+' and 'Galaxy AI'.
Bottom Left: Three rear-view phones in graphite black, coral pink, and warm champagne finishes arranged in a slight arc.
Bottom Right: One front-facing phone with a soft pink abstract wallpaper and centered punch-hole camera.
Center/Background: Bright minimal off-white field with substantial negative space and a tiny legal footnote at the lower left.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle matte reflections, clean soft shadows, airy premium ecommerce atmosphere

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Samsung.com only Galaxy S25 and S25+ color lineup poster. Centerpiece is a minimal arrangement of three rear-view Galaxy S25/S25+ devices in graphite black, coral pink, and warm champagne, plus one front-facing phone with a soft pink abstract wallpaper. Background is a bright off-white premium ecommerce field with lots of negative space. Surrounding elements: exact top title 'Samsung.com only', subheading 'Galaxy S25 | S25+' and 'Galaxy AI', and a tiny legal footnote at the bottom left. Technical style: photorealistic product render, soft studio lighting, gentle matte reflections and clean soft shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use refs for the exact colors and wallpaper. This visual works because of its spare composition, so keep the off-white background wide and uncluttered rather than adding extra props or labels.
